user.title: Firefox Sync
user.description: The admin UI's metrics (every entity), the public URLs of the services (their health and versions, no admin UI needed), or both.

data_description.url: Where Home Assistant reaches the admin UI, for example http://192.168.1.10:8090. Empty: no admin UI, the URLs below only.
data_description.sync_url: The public URL of the Sync server (SYNC_PUBLIC_URL), for its health and version. Required with any URL below.

connection.name: Connection
connection.description: For every URL above: TLS verification, a custom CA, a client certificate (the client certificates of firefox-sync's docs/access-control.md). Each certificate and key is PEM text, pasted, or the path of a file Home Assistant can read.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a test setup: without it anybody between Home Assistant and the stack can read the metrics token.
data_description.ca_cert: The CA of a private certificate, such as the stack's own (Caddy's internal CA, step-ca...).
data_description.client_cert: With client certificates in front of the stack: the certificate Home Assistant presents.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the metrics of the admin UI: {error}
error.invalid_auth: The admin UI refused the token, or its metrics are off (ADMIN_METRICS_TOKEN empty).
error.invalid_url: Not an http or https URL (the pairing server: ws or wss too).
error.invalid_tls: The connection options do not load: {error}
error.token_required: The admin UI's metrics need its token.
error.sync_url_required: The accounts' URLs need the Sync server's URL too.
error.no_source: Give the admin UI's URL and token, or the Sync server's URL, or both.
error.service_down: {service} does not answer at this URL: {error}
error.url_credentials: No user or password in the URL: the admin UI is reached with its metrics token, a server behind access control with a client certificate.

abort.already_configured: This admin UI or Sync server is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This Firefox Sync add-on is already being set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The add-on sent an incomplete discovery.
abort.reauth_successful: The new metrics token works: the entry is loaded again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry is updated and loaded again.

invalid_auth.message: The admin UI refused the metrics token.
